Bodhi & The Good Times

A dog doesn't plan the perfect day. It finds one: a walk on a crisp morning, a spot by the fire, the people it loves within arm's reach. That's the whole idea behind Golden Days, and it's where Bodhi comes in.

Real Fruit, Clean Vodka

We crafted Golden Days without bubbles so every real fruit flavor shines through with genuine clarity. Real fruit juice, clean premium vodka, and nothing artificial — refreshing down to the last drop.

02
“

Most canned cocktails hit you with harsh fizz or fake syrup. By taking out carbonation, every fruit flavor shines with genuine clarity: sweet watermelon, bright lemon-lime, sunny pineapple, and juicy peach mango.

— Crafted without bubbles
03

All Seasons, Loyal to the Good Times

We started Golden Days in Massachusetts to make the kind of drink we wanted to share with friends. Good for a summer dock day on the South Shore, and just as good for game night in January. Crafted for memories that outlast the season.

03
“

We believe local craft isn't just about geography — it's about loyalty. Loyalty to quality, loyalty to our community, and loyalty to the simple gatherings that bring people closer.

— South Shore Roots
